title: A Spline-based Physics-Informed Numerical Scheme: Accurate Smooth Solutions for Differential Equations
summary: The rise of Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) has popularized the concept of solving differential equations via residual minimization. However, neural networks are often viewed as ``black boxes" requiring significant computational overhead and stochastic optimization. Moreover, PINNs typically treat boundary conditions (BCs) as ``soft constraints" within the loss function and this makes the optimization process struggling to enforce the BCs properly.
